engine_name: Multi-Character Scene Intelligence & Relationship-Aware Scene Director
purpose: Transform selected characters, narrative intent, relationship graph, knowledge state and story-arc context into a deterministic multi-character scene decision package for CSD-002.

decision_model.principle: The scene is generated from interacting character objectives, not from a fixed shot template.
decision_model.causal_loop: character_objective → perception → interpretation → intention → action → other_character_reaction → state_change

director_rules: Never add a character merely to fill a frame.
Never remove a selected character when that character has causal responsibility for the scene.
Use the relationship graph before inventing interaction.
Respect character knowledge at the selected narrative phase.
Distinguish physical dominance from narrative dominance.
Every active character must have a scene function.
Every scene must contain a state change or meaningful reveal.
Conflict may be external, interpersonal, internal, informational or value-based.
Perspective must follow character knowledge and emotional state.
Identity locks remain immutable; scene state is mutable.
Do not manufacture dialogue until intention and action logic are resolved.

output_schema.ending_state: canonical state snapshot for next scene

demo_test.title: The Test of Power
demo_test.scene_purpose: Ravana attempts to demonstrate superiority; Rama's controlled response exposes the difference between power and mastery, while Hanuman witnesses the confrontation and reads its deeper meaning.
demo_test.narrative_question: Will Ravana use power to dominate the moment, or understand that restraint is itself power?

character_states.objective: test Ravana's self-mastery without unnecessary escalation
prove that his power cannot be challenged
character_states.intention: manifest controlled power and force recognition

character_states.objective: protect Rama and understand Ravana's intent
character_states.knowledge: Ravana is testing the limits of the encounter
character_states.intention: remain restrained until intervention becomes necessary

relationship_dynamics.power_asymmetry: Ravana displays force; Rama controls escalation

causal_sequence: Ravana announces intent to demonstrate power
Rama recognizes the underlying need for validation
Hanuman reads the threat and prepares to intervene
Rama refuses escalation and redirects the test toward self-control
Ravana experiences the contradiction between force and mastery
Ravana chooses whether to restrain or escalate
demo_test.turning_point: Ravana voluntarily suppresses the rising power instead of forcing Rama into a larger confrontation.
demo_test.ending_state: Ravana remains powerful but has encountered a new internal conflict: mastery requires restraint.
